line: I don’t wanna go back broke but I wanna live moments again I just wanna feel at home, and I wanna feel at home (Yeah, yeah)
vault_lines: I don't wanna go back broke but I wanna live moments again
meaning: SoFaygo expresses that while he does not miss the hardship of his old lifestyle, he misses the comfort of its familiarity and wishes to relive the moments that made him feel at home.

line: It was never in the plans, now I got them diamonds they dance
vault_lines: It was never in the plans, now I got them diamonds they dance
meaning: In this verse Faygo makes reference to another of his songs “Diamonds dancing (Over)”, and he could also be referring to the previous verse about the one whit the ball in his hands, or referring to the act that he never had Planned to have jewelry
This is the tag for one of the song’s producers, Jammarius Hill, known professionally as Trgc.
